cpu_recipe: One distinct physical NUMA1 core and its SMT sibling per tool; eight original model cores on NUMA0. Fixed for all cells, one numerical thread. Affinity is not reservation. Fresh 24/3 anchor; not pooled with old two-core/tool timings.

memory_budget.note: 120GiB is sum of per-tool RLIMIT_AS limits, not measured resident allocation. Admission snapshots do not establish exclusive memory bandwidth.

matrix.purpose: pressure generalization on known development workload; not new-parent evidence
matrix.prefix_guard: Before reserving any generation validate each actual prompt cached-block count <= cell capacity; no silent truncation, compression, prompt padding or no-cache bypass.
matrix.timing_rule: Fresh complete crossover per cell. Never pool prior legacy matrix or 24/3 means into new averages.
matrix.host_recipe: Fresh real tool CPU/SMT/NUMA plan for 10 concurrent tasks; account aggregate memory and all runnable tool threads. Reusing three CPU groups without documenting contention is forbidden.
matrix.failure_rule: Stop at first native/protocol/quality/resource/source violation, seal all affected ledgers; no replacement batches or posthoc threshold relaxation.

preflight.failure_rule: Stop at first quality/resource failure, retain evidence, no replacement.

resource_change: Static child launcher sets and verifies CPU affinity, MPOL_BIND, process THP disable and RLIMIT_AS/CPU before Python exec. Worker verifies inheritance before legacy imports. All arms share same recipe and overhead. No global changes. Not proven historical fault cause.

qualification.failure_rule: Stop on first quality/control/qualification fault or I/O violation. Preserve old failed recipe and every new result. No replacement or posthoc relaxation.

native_gate_scopes: First24/10 diagnostic only. Larger capacities use separately frozen existing matrix progression; no aggregate-budget increase.
